If they talk about their dachshund more than anything else, this personalised dachshund word art print is the gift for them: a sausage dog portrait in soft greys, filled with the words that sum their dog up. It's a lovely gift for a new puppy, a dog's birthday or a dog-mad friend.

Your personalised dachshund word art print, made with your words

Type the dog's name in the first box; it appears once, in pride of place. In the second box, type 20 to 30 words separated by commas: nicknames, favourite walks, toys, treats and the people they love. We repeat them in different sizes, fonts and shades to fill the design. The preview shows your details before you add it to your basket.

Tips: use single words or phrases of no more than three words, put commas between them and check your spelling. No icons, emoji or accented letters, please. We print exactly what you type.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • One of a kind: every word comes from you, so no two prints are the same
  • The name stands out once, and your other words repeat in different sizes, fonts and shades
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order

Size & details

  • Design: a sausage dog portrait in soft greys, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Your personalised dachshund word art print is posted the next working day, or the same day if you order before 12pm, by Royal Mail.

Pair it with a matching dog mug for the ultimate dog lover's gift.

Fans of the Harry Potter books and films will love this personalised pop figure word art print. It shows a potions master pop figure in black and grey, inspired by Severus Snape and made from the words you choose.

Make your own personalised pop figure word art print

The name box comes first, and whatever you type there is shown once, nice and big. Then add 20 to 30 words, with a comma between each: family names, favourite moments and in-jokes. We repeat your words in different sizes, fonts and shades until the figure is full. Check the preview before you order.

Short words work best. We print exactly what you type, so check the spelling.

Why you'll love it

  • Premium Display frames in black or silver: thick, chunky and very professional, not cheap thin frames
  • High-quality full-colour print, made to order
  • Four print-only sizes, from a shelf-sized A4 to a statement A1

Size & details

  • Design: a potions master pop figure in black and grey, filled with your name and 20–30 words
  • Print only: A4 (210 x 297 mm), A3 (297 x 420 mm), A2 (420 x 594 mm) or A1 (594 x 841 mm)
  • Paper: A4 on 350gsm card, A3 on 170gsm gloss, A2 and A1 on 210gsm gloss
  • Framed: A4 (with a stand) or A3 (with a hanging clip) in a black or silver Premium Display frame

Delivery

Posted the next working day (same day if you order before 12pm) by Royal Mail. Collect the set and hang them side by side.

Please note

This is an unofficial design inspired by Severus Snape from the Harry Potter books and films, drawn in the style of collectable pop vinyl figures. It is not official merchandise and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected with Harry Potter, J.K. Rowling, Warner Bros. Entertainment or Funko, or any of their licensees. All names, characters and trademarks belong to their respective owners.
